title: Beduk Pertama Mail
subject: a twelve-year-old boy allowed to strike the old surau beduk for maghrib for the first time, whose nervous first hit comes a beat early while the whole kampung waits
caption: Malay qasidah rebana pop, Malay-world qasidah song with modern pop arrangement. Interlocking rebana frame drums, deep low beduk drum hits on downbeats, gambus oud melody lines, legato violin, soft electric bass. Warm acoustic room production. Male lead vocal, mid register, gentle and clearly sung, mixed chorus answering in unison. 84 BPM, D minor. Tender, proud evening mood. No EDM, no trap beats, no autotune, no rap, no rock guitars.
lyrics:
[Intro - rebana, gambus]

[Verse 1]
Tok Siak hulur kayu pemukul
Tangan Mail sejuk, peluh di dahi
Matahari turun belakang sawah
Satu kampung pandang ke surau

[Pre-Chorus]
Tunggu, Mail, tunggu sekejap
Belum lagi masanya

[Chorus]
Dum, beduk pertama Mail
Awal sedetik, semua tersenyum
Tok Siak tepuk bahu dia
Tak apa, esok kita cuba lagi

[Verse 2]
Mak dia berdiri tepi tangga
Ayah sorok senyum dalam kopiah
Kawan-kawan dah berhenti main
Bunyi tadi sampai ke hujung jalan

[Chorus]
Dum, beduk pertama Mail
Awal sedetik, semua tersenyum
Tok Siak beri kayu semula
Esok, Mail, giliran kau lagi

[Outro - beduk, rebana fade]
Dum, perlahan, dum
Maghrib pun tiba
